# toml-test

The files of [toml-test](https://github.com/toml-lang/toml-test) release **v2.2.0** that its
`files-toml-1.0.0` and `files-toml-1.1.0` lists name, byte for byte, under its MIT license
(`LICENSE`). `conformance_test.cj` holds `ftoml` to them in every `cjpm test`.

To move to another release: copy its `tests/files-toml-*` and every file they list over these, and
change the version above.
